newsitem.title: USA: Waste Recovery closes NIPSCO deal.
newsitem.headline: Waste Recovery closes NIPSCO deal.

text.p: Waste Recovery Inc of Dallas said in a release received here that it concluded the previously announced acquisition of NIPSCO Industries Inc's 55 percent interest in WR-Illinois.
In return for its interest, NIPSCO will receive 1.1 million shares of Waste Recovery common stock.
WR-Illinois was initially a partnership between Waste Recovery and NIPSCO operating two TDF (tire derived fuel) processing facilities in Illinois.
The two plants have a combined capacity to process 15 million tires per year into TDF.
